name: Hotel Sun Valley
beschreibung: Hotel Sun Valley is peacefully situated in Wildschönau, offering panoramic views of the surrounding Tyrolean Alps. The property blends traditional alpine design with contemporary amenities. Guest rooms feature private balconies, satellite TV, and modern en-suite bathrooms. An inviting wellness area with sauna, steam bath, and relaxation rooms provides rejuvenation after an active day outdoors. Half-board dining includes a hearty breakfast buffet and multi-course dinners highlighting regional and international recipes. In winter, the local ski bus provides seamless access to the Ski Juwel Alpbachtal Wildschönau slopes, while scenic hiking and mountain biking trails start directly at the doorstep during summer.
kurzbeschreibung: Quietly situated hotel in Wildschönau offering Tyrolean charm, wellness facilities, and regional dining.
